proof_body:
by
  intro a b z k hk hk1
  have hk2 : 1 - k ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have : (k - 1) * (k + 1) = 0 := by linarith
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this with h | h
    · exact hk1 (by linarith)
    · linarith
  have hkC : (1 - (k : ℂ) ^ 2) = ((1 - k ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; rfl
  have hkC0 : (1 - (k : ℂ) ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by rw [hkC]; exact_mod_cast hk2
  have hd : |1 - k ^ 2| ≠ 0 := abs_ne_zero.mpr hk2
  have hn : ∀ w : ℂ, ‖w‖ ^ 2 = w.re ^ 2 + w.im ^ 2 := by
    intro w
    rw [Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_apply]; ring
  have e : (1 - (k : ℂ) ^ 2) * (z - (a - (k : ℂ) ^ 2 * b) / (1 - (k : ℂ) ^ 2)) = (z - a) - ((k ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (z - b) := by
    push_cast
    field_simp
    ring
  have h1 : ‖z - (a - (k : ℂ) ^ 2 * b) / (1 - (k : ℂ) ^ 2)‖ * |1 - k ^ 2| = ‖(z - a) - ((k ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (z - b)‖ := by
    rw [← e, norm_mul, hkC, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_comm]
  have hab : a - b = (z - b) - (z - a) := by ring
  have hid : ‖(z - a) - ((k ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (z - b)‖ ^ 2 - (k * ‖a - b‖) ^ 2 = (1 - k ^ 2) * (‖z - a‖ ^ 2 - (k * ‖z - b‖) ^ 2) := by
    rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, hn, hn (a - b), hn (z - a), hn (z - b), hab]
    simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.re_ofReal_mul, Complex.im_ofReal_mul]
    ring
  rw [eq_div_iff hd, h1]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h2 : ‖(z - a) - ((k ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (z - b)‖ ^ 2 = (k * ‖a - b‖) ^ 2 := by
      have : ‖z - a‖ ^ 2 - (k * ‖z - b‖) ^ 2 = 0 := by rw [h]; ring
      rw [this, mul_zero] at hid
      linarith
    exact (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mp h2
  · intro h
    have h2 : (1 - k ^ 2) * (‖z - a‖ ^ 2 - (k * ‖z - b‖) ^ 2) = 0 := by rw [← hid, h]; ring
    have h3 := (mul_eq_zero.mp h2).resolve_left hk2
    exact (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mp (by linarith)
